name: Turn on .NET Framework 2.0, 3.5, and 4.8
description: Enables the NetFx3 and NetFx4-AdvSrvs Windows components to run applications built for .NET Framework 2.0, 3.0, 3.5, and 4.x.

name: Synchronize system time with pool.ntp.org
description: Starts the Windows Time service, configures pool.ntp.org as the manual time peer, and forces an immediate clock resynchronization.

name: Turn on Hyper-V
description: Enables the Microsoft-Hyper-V-All platform component to create and run hardware virtual machines.

name: Turn on Windows Media Player and DirectPlay
description: Enables the WindowsMediaPlayer, MediaPlayback, DirectPlay, and LegacyComponents optional packages for older media tools and games.

name: Turn on Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)
description: Enables the VirtualMachinePlatform and Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux components to run Linux distributions on Windows.

name: Turn on the NFS network client
description: Enables the Windows NFS client components, sets default anonymous UID and GID values to 0, and configures file access permissions.

name: Schedule daily registry backups
description: Turns on periodic Configuration Manager registry backups, keeps two backup copies, and registers a daily task at 00:30.

name: Turn on the F8 boot recovery menu
description: Configures the boot manager menu policy so pressing F8 during startup opens Advanced Boot Options.

name: Turn off the F8 boot recovery menu
description: Sets the boot configuration menu policy back to standard.

name: Turn on Windows Sandbox
description: Enables the Containers-DisposableClientVM component to run temporary isolated desktop sessions.

name: Apply selected Windows components
description: Installs the checked optional Windows components in a single batch.

name: Run Sysinternals Autologon
description: Downloads Autologon.exe from Sysinternals, checks its digital signature, and launches it to configure automatic sign-in.

name: Reset Windows Update
description: Restarts update services, deletes BITS queue files, renames the update cache, clears WSUS client keys, re-registers update DLLs, and resets Winsock.

name: Reset the network stack
description: Resets the Winsock catalog and the IPv4 and IPv6 TCP/IP stack through netsh.

name: Run the DISM and SFC repair scan
description: Checks the system drive with chkdsk, repairs system files with sfc /scannow, and restores the component store with DISM.

name: Repair WinGet
description: Re-registers the Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller package for the current user to restore the winget command.

name: Computer Management
description: Opens the Computer Management console (compmgmt.msc).

name: Control Panel
description: Opens the classic Windows Control Panel.

name: Mouse Properties
description: Opens the Mouse Properties dialog (main.cpl).

name: Network Connections
description: Opens the Network Connections adapter folder (ncpa.cpl).

name: Power options
description: Opens the Power Options control panel (powercfg.cpl).

name: Devices and Printers
description: Opens the classic Devices and Printers shell folder.

name: Programs and Features
description: Opens the desktop program uninstaller window (appwiz.cpl).

name: Region
description: Opens the Region and date format dialog (intl.cpl).

name: Security and Maintenance
description: Opens the Security and Maintenance control panel (wscui.cpl).

name: Sound
description: Opens the Sound playback and recording dialog (mmsys.cpl).

name: System Properties
description: Opens the System Properties dialog (sysdm.cpl).

name: Date and Time
description: Opens the Date and Time dialog (timedate.cpl).

name: Windows Defender Firewall
description: Opens the Windows Defender Firewall control panel (firewall.cpl).

name: System Restore
description: Launches the System Restore wizard (rstrui.exe).

name: Install the WindowCraft PowerShell profile
description: Writes a PowerShell 7 profile with history search, a prompt that shows the git branch and a few short commands. The previous profile is kept as a backup. Nothing is downloaded.

name: Remove the WindowCraft PowerShell profile
description: Deletes the WindowCraft profile and puts the backed-up profile back. A profile you wrote yourself afterwards stays.

name: Set up OpenSSH Server
description: Adds the OpenSSH Server capability, starts sshd and ssh-agent, opens inbound TCP port 22, and copies authorized keys with restricted permissions.
